description: This file defines the virtual class CKEDITOR.eventInfo, which models the event object passed to event listeners in the CKEditor framework. It includes documentation for properties like name, sender, editor, data, listenerData, and methods like stop() and cancel(). The file is for documentation purposes and does not contain executable code.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.eventInfo
classes.description: Virtual class illustrating the features of the event object passed to event listeners in CKEditor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Indicates that no further listeners are to be called for the event.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Indicates that the event is to be canceled if it is cancelable.
